summary: Evidence-backed acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation covering atomic reservation, expedited priority handling, idempotent order identifiers, and immutable input handling.

requirements.description: All lines of an order must be reserved atomically in aggregate, combining repeated SKUs and either fulfilling all lines or leaving stock unchanged.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: an initial stock object and an order with multiple or repeated SKU lines
acceptance.when: reservation is attempted for the order
acceptance.then: all repeated SKU lines are aggregated, and stock is only deducted if all requested SKU quantities are available; otherwise stock remains unchanged

requirements.description: Orders with expedited priority must be allocated stock prior to normal priority orders, preserving arrival order within each priority group.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: a set of orders containing both expedited and normal priorities
acceptance.then: expedited orders are evaluated first in their original arrival order, followed by normal orders in their original arrival order

requirements.description: Order IDs are idempotent; only the first occurrence of an order ID is processed, and subsequent duplicate IDs are ignored entirely.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: a batch of orders containing duplicate order identifiers
acceptance.then: the first occurrence claims the identifier and any subsequent order sharing that identifier is ignored entirely

requirements.description: Orders with invalid lines or invalid metadata are rejected without modifying stock, and caller input data structures are never mutated.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: orders with invalid lines or invalid priorities and caller stock inputs
acceptance.then: invalid orders or lines are rejected without stock deduction, and input stock and order objects remain unmutated

assumptions: Stock is provided as a plain JavaScript object mapping non-empty SKU string identifiers to non-negative safe integers.
Order lines are supplied as a non-empty array of objects with non-empty string SKU identifiers and positive safe-integer quantities.
Orders require a non-empty string ID and a priority of either 'expedited' or 'normal'.
Duplicate order IDs are ignored on subsequent occurrences even if the first occurrence was rejected for invalid priority.
Invalid order rejections are recorded in input order first, followed by reservation failures in order processing sequence.
